say:1:1621776001:1.text: It's only been one night, and all I get are cold stares from my friends. Let me guess why...
say:1:1621776001:1.source_cn: 亲爱的朋友们……只过了短短一个晚上，你们看我的眼神却变...

say:2:1621776002:1.text: <style="highlight">You know I'm the mirror monster, don't you?</style>

say:4:1621776004:1.text: I knew you all were looking for me, and I saw you there in the library.
say:4:1621776004:1.source_cn: 我知道你们在找我，也在图书馆里看到了你们。

say:5:1621776005:1.text: ... So I did hear that grunt yesterday! It was you!
say:5:1621776005:1.source_cn: ……那天，那天那个在图书馆发出声音的，果然是你！

say:6:1621776006:1.text: Yup. I saw you found the key evidence against me.
say:6:1621776006:1.source_cn: 嗯，是啊。我很清楚，你们找到了对我而言足以致命的线索。

choice_prompt:7:1621776006.text: Yup. I saw you found the key evidence against me.
choice_prompt:7:1621776006.source_cn: 嗯，是啊。我很清楚，你们找到了对我而言足以致命的线索。

say:8:1621776007:1.text: There's no point in running. You'd just bring me back anyway, right?
say:8:1621776007:1.source_cn: 因为逃跑没有用啊。你会把我抓回来，对吧？

say:9:1621776009:1.text: That duel with you after lunch made it clear I'm no match for you.
say:9:1621776009:1.source_cn: 昨天午餐后的那次切磋，足以让我认识到我和你之间实力的差...
say:9:1621776009:1.male: That duel with you after lunch made it clear I'm no match for you.
say:9:1621776009:1.female: That duel with you after lunch made it clear I'm no match for you.

say:10:1621776010:1.text: Instead of running and suffering the shame of being caught, I'd rather face you directly and tell you the truth.
say:10:1621776010:1.source_cn: 与其逃跑再被你抓回来，落得个狼狈的收场……不如坦然赴约...

say:11:1621776011:1.text: Yes, I'm the mirror monster, and I don't belong here. But my friends, ask yourselves—<style="highlight">does Girod truly want me sent back</style>?
say:11:1621776011:1.source_cn: 没错，我是镜中人。我非常清楚，我应该被收回镜子里。但是...

say:13:1621776012:1.text: What are you getting at? Obviously, Girod wants to get back to his life!
say:13:1621776012:1.source_cn: 你这话是什么意思？回归现实，把你关回镜子，当然是吉罗德...

say:14:1621776013:1.text: Honey, you're wrong. What Girod truly desires is to become his ideal self. He made that wish to me, and I granted it.
say:14:1621776013:1.source_cn: 不，可爱的小姐。你错了。吉罗德真正想要的，是成为理想中...

say:15:1621776014:1.text: While I stood in for him, I perfected every assessment and cast spells far out of his league.
say:15:1621776014:1.source_cn: 在我顶替他的这段时间，我完美地替他完成了绝大多数考核。...

say:16:1621776015:1.text: I got him into the vocal club and made lots of friends. What's more, I even started a band, with plans to enter a music contest.
say:16:1621776015:1.source_cn: 我替他通过了声乐社团的入团考核，交了不少朋友，还准备组...

say:17:1621776016:1.text: I'm the person he's always longed to be, and I've made his impossible dream a reality.
say:17:1621776016:1.source_cn: 现在的我，就是他理想中的自己。我让他那个永生都不可能实...
say:17:1621776016:1.male: I'm the person he's always longed to be, and I've made his impossible dream a reality.
say:17:1621776016:1.female: I'm the person he's always longed to be, and I've made his impossible dream a reality.

say:20:1621776018:1.text: I can feel you wavering, my friends. You spoke with the real Girod, didn't you? You must know I'm right.
say:20:1621776018:1.source_cn: 你们犹豫了，我亲爱的朋友。你们和真正的吉罗德说过话了，...

say:21:1621776019:1.text: If you let him out, he'll fall straight back to mediocrity. All his progress will disappear. Wouldn't that be cruel to him?
say:21:1621776019:1.source_cn: 可如果你们把我关回镜子，让真正的吉罗德出来，他只会再一...

say:22:1621776020:1.text: Now, consider the second option—keeping things as they are. Girod can exist as his ideal self, and I get to live my own life...
say:22:1621776020:1.source_cn: 当然，我们还有另一种选择——保持现状。吉罗德会以自己理...

say:23:1621776021:1.text: It's a perfect win-win solution, don't you think?
say:23:1621776021:1.source_cn: 这样对我和吉罗德都好，这就是最完美的结局，不是吗？

say:25:1621776022:1.text: ... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we don't know what to do. You should decide...
say:25:1621776022:1.male: ... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we don't know what to do. You should decide...
say:25:1621776022:1.female: ... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we don't know what to do. You should decide...

choice_prompt:26:1621776022.male: ... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we don't know what to do. You should decide...
choice_prompt:26:1621776022.female: ... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we don't know what to do. You should decide...

say:28:1621776023:1.text: Alas... I knew it'd be hard to convince you.
say:28:1621776023:1.male: Alas... I knew it'd be hard to convince you.
say:28:1621776023:1.female: Alas... I knew it'd be hard to convince you.

say:29:1621776024:1.text: Just let me put up one last fight...
say:29:1621776024:1.source_cn: 既然这样，就让我进行一点最后的挣扎吧……
say:29:1621776024:1.male: Just let me put up one last fight...
say:29:1621776024:1.female: Just let me put up one last fight...

say:32:1621776025:1.text: Thank you... I really mean it.
say:32:1621776025:1.male: Thank you... I really mean it.
say:32:1621776025:1.female: Thank you... I really mean it.

say:33:1621776026:1.text: Trust me, Girod would be grateful as well... If you don't believe me, you can ask him yourself.
say:33:1621776026:1.source_cn: 请相信我，真正的吉罗德也会感谢你……如果你依旧心存疑虑...
say:33:1621776026:1.male: Trust me, Girod would be grateful as well... If you don't believe me, you can ask him yourself.
say:33:1621776026:1.female: Trust me, Girod would be grateful as well... If you don't believe me, you can ask him yourself.

say:34:1621776008:1.text: Not at all. In fact, I know I don't stand a chance.
say:34:1621776008:1.source_cn: 不，正相反。我很清楚，我没有胜算。

choice:7:1:2.text: Do you think we can't stop you?
choice:7:1:2.male: Do you think we can't stop you?
choice:7:1:2.female: Do you think we can't stop you?
